attributes.description: Inventory of Google groups: membership, owners and managers, nested groups, admin roles and external exposure.

params.markdown:
The Groups Inventory dashboard shows the **inventory** of Google groups collected by the `group_inventory` data stream: one document per group per collection cycle. It describes what exists, not what happened; group changes are in the Groups and Group Enterprise dashboards.

Groups are collected once per interval (24 hours by default), so the dashboard opens on the last 24 hours. Counts are unique groups. Member counts include only direct members, not the members of nested groups. A member is external when its email domain is not the domain of any collected group.

**Who can join**, **Who can view membership** and the settings tiles show data only when the optional group settings setting is enabled, and **Admin roles** only when the admin roles setting is enabled.

A group's `group.id` equals `user.group.id` on its members in the Users dashboard.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/google_workspace/)**
